verdict.rationale: Convex supports bulk-ish operations via `npx convex import` for bulk data loading and functions can perform arbitrary batch reads/writes in TypeScript/mutations, plus MCP/CLI access lets an AI agent script these. However, there's no documented bulk update/delete API, no batch mutation primitive, and no evidence of a UI or CLI command for bulk editing many existing rows at once beyond import. missing for 10: dedicated bulk update/delete operations, batch mutation API documentation, hands-on evidence of bulk operations at scale, independent confirmation of performance/limits for large batch writes.
